items.title: Efficacy and safety of mitapivat in adults with transfusion-dependent α-thalassaemia or β-thalassaemia (ENERGIZE-T): a double-blind, randomised, multicentre, placebo-controlled, phase 3 trial
items.summary: A phase 3 trial found mitapivat to be the first oral disease-modifying therapy for adults with transfusion-dependent α-thalassaemia or β-thalassaemia, significantly reducing transfusion burden with a favorable benefit-risk profile.
items.curatedReason: Mitapivat 作为首个口服疾病修正疗法，显著降低了输血依赖型 α/β-地贫成人患者的输血负担，且耐受性良好。这为这类患者带来了新的治疗选择， PT 可将其纳入患者教育和多学科协作考量。
items.titleZh: Mitapivat 治疗输血依赖性 α-地贫或 β-地贫成人患者的疗效与安全性（ENERGIZE-T）：一项双盲、随机、多中心、安慰剂对照的 3 期试验
items.summaryZh: 一项 3 期试验显示，Mitapivat 是首个用于治疗输血依赖性 α-地贫或 β-地贫成人患者的口服疾病修正疗法，显著降低了输血负担，并具有良好的获益-风险比。
items.curatedReasonEn: Mitapivat, as the first oral disease-modifying therapy, significantly reduced transfusion burden in adults with transfusion-dependent α/β-thalassaemia and was well-tolerated. This offers a new treatment option for these patients, which PTs can incorporate into patient education and multidisciplinary collaboration.
items.limitation: 研究仅关注成人患者，且主要结局为输血负担。
items.limitationEn: The study focused only on adult patients, and the primary outcome was transfusion burden.

items.title: Patient-reported knee osteoarthritis problems and rehabilitation goals: A qualitative study.
items.summary: A qualitative study of 387 knee osteoarthritis patients revealed that their most problematic issues included pain, activity limitations, and participation restrictions, while their 3-month rehabilitation goals centered on walking more, becoming more active, improving ADLs, general well-being, and meaningful activities.
items.curatedReason: 这项定性研究深入挖掘了膝骨关节炎患者最关注的症状和康复目标，发现患者常以高阶体育活动为目标。这提示我们，在制定个性化康复计划时，务必将患者的个体化高阶目标纳入考量，而非仅限于基本 ADL 恢复。
items.titleZh: 膝骨关节炎患者报告的问题及康复目标：一项定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 387 例膝骨关节炎患者的定性研究显示，他们最关注的问题包括疼痛、活动受限和参与受限，而 3 个月内的康复目标则集中于增加步行能力、提高身体活动度、改善日常生活活动、提升整体健康和参与有意义的活动。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study delves into patients' most pressing symptoms and rehabilitation goals for knee osteoarthritis, revealing a frequent focus on high-level physical activities. This highlights the importance of incorporating individualized, high-level goals into personalized rehabilitation plans, moving beyond basic ADL restoration.
items.limitation: 定性研究，可能存在样本选择偏差，且未明确具体干预方案。
items.limitationEn: Qualitative study, potential for sample selection bias, and specific intervention details are not provided.

items.title: Fall-prevention education after achieving independent walking is associated with reduced subsequent fall risk in patients with stroke: a retrospective pre-post intervention study.
items.summary: A retrospective pre-post intervention study (1,437 stroke patients) found that standardized fall-prevention education delivered immediately after achieving independent walking was associated with a significantly lower adjusted hazard of the first fall (aHR: 0.58, 95% CI: 0.43-0.76, P<.001) and a lower fall incidence rate (IRR: 0.68, 95% CI: 0.51-0.90, P=.006).
items.curatedReason: 卒中患者在实现独立行走后立即接受标准化防跌倒教育，能够显著降低后续跌倒风险。将这一标准化教育流程纳入你的卒中康复末期方案，强化患者对风险的认知，以改善长期结局。
items.titleZh: 卒中患者在实现独立行走后接受防跌倒教育与后续跌倒风险降低相关：一项回顾性干预前后研究
items.summaryZh: 一项回顾性干预前后研究（1,437 名卒中患者）发现，在实现独立行走后立即接受标准化防跌倒教育的患者，首次跌倒的调整风险显著降低（aHR: 0.58），跌倒发生率也更低（IRR: 0.68）。
items.curatedReasonEn: Standardized fall-prevention education delivered immediately after achieving independent walking in stroke patients significantly reduces subsequent fall risk. Integrate this standardized education process into your late-stage stroke rehabilitation protocols to enhance patient risk awareness and improve long-term outcomes.
items.limitation: 回顾性研究设计可能存在选择偏倚和混杂因素，不能完全排除其他影响因素。
items.limitationEn: The retrospective study design may have selection bias and confounding factors, and cannot completely rule out other influencing factors.

items.title: The Added Value of Neural Mobilization Techniques to Proprioceptive Neuromuscular Facilitation in Patients With Adhesive Capsulitis: Randomized Controlled Trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (n=56) found that combining neural mobilization techniques (NMTs) with proprioceptive neuromuscular facilitation (PNF) and conventional physical therapy led to statistically significant short-term improvements in pain, disability, and passive shoulder ROM in patients with adhesive capsulitis. However, only the 14.08° improvement in shoulder abduction approached the established MCID.
items.curatedReason: 虽然这项 RCT 显示神经松动术联合 PNF 能在统计学上改善肩周炎疼痛、功能障碍和 ROM，但除肩外展 ROM 外，其他结果均未达到临床最小重要差异 (MCID)。这意味着多数改善的临床意义有限。
items.titleZh: 神经松动术联合本体感受神经肌肉促进技术对肩周炎患者的附加价值：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验 (n=56) 显示，神经松动术联合本体感受神经肌肉促进技术 (PNF) 和常规物理治疗，能统计学显著地在短期内改善肩周炎患者的疼痛、功能障碍和肩关节被动活动度。但仅肩外展改善 14.08° 接近临床最小重要差异 (MCID)。
items.curatedReasonEn: While this RCT showed statistically significant improvements in pain, disability, and ROM for adhesive capsulitis with neural mobilization plus PNF, most outcomes, except shoulder abduction ROM, did not meet the minimal clinically important difference (MCID). This suggests limited clinical meaningfulness for most observed improvements.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小 (n=56)，随访时间仅 6 周，且多数结局指标的组间差异未达到临床最小重要差异 (MCID)，限制了结果的长期外推性与临床意义。
items.limitationEn: The study has a small sample size (n=56) and a short follow-up of only 6 weeks, and most outcome measures' between-group differences did not reach the MCID, limiting long-term generalizability and clinical significance.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Effects of High-Intensity Laser Therapy on Functional Outcomes and Spasticity-Related Pain in Subacute and Chronic Stroke Patients with Plantar Flexor Spasticity: A Randomized Sham-Controlled Trial.
items.summary: A randomized sham-controlled trial (N=24) found high-intensity laser therapy (HILT) significantly reduced spasticity-related pain (P<0.001) and showed a covariate-adjusted gait speed benefit (0.089 m/s, 95% CI 0.003-0.176; P=0.043) in subacute/chronic stroke patients with plantar flexor spasticity, when combined with conventional rehabilitation.
items.curatedReason: 高强度激光（HILT）作为卒中后足底屈肌痉挛的辅助疗法，对缓解疼痛有效。它在改善步态方面有统计学益处，但临床意义尚待更大样本验证，别急于将其作为主要步态干预。
items.titleZh: 高强度激光疗法对亚急性和慢性卒中患者足底屈肌痉挛引起的功能结局和痉挛相关疼痛的影响：一项随机假对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机假对照试验（N=24）发现，高强度激光疗法（HILT）结合常规康复，能显著减轻亚急性及慢性卒中患者足底屈肌痉挛相关的疼痛（P<0.001），并显示出协变量调整后的步态速度改善（0.089 m/s，95% CI 0.003-0.176；P=0.043）。
items.curatedReasonEn: High-intensity laser therapy (HILT) is effective for pain relief as an adjunct in subacute and chronic stroke patients with plantar flexor spasticity. While it showed a statistical gait benefit, its clinical significance requires larger trials, so avoid prioritizing it as a primary gait intervention.
items.limitation: 这是一项初步的小样本试验，步态改善的临床意义尚不明确，且未报告长期随访数据。
items.limitationEn: This is a preliminary trial with a small sample size, and the clinical significance of gait improvement remains unclear; long-term follow-up data were not reported.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: When evidence fails in real life: Rethinking sports injury rehabilitation and prevention.
items.summary: This commentary critically examines traditional linear, reductionist models in sports injury prevention and rehabilitation, advocating for an integrated, complexity-informed framework that incorporates dynamic biopsychosocial thinking and a comprehensive interpretation of evidence-based practice to enhance patient-centered care.
items.curatedReason: 传统运动损伤康复和预防的线性还原论方法有局限性。要开始用复杂系统思维、动态生物心理社会模型和整合性循证实践框架来审视你的临床决策，这能帮你更好地适应运动员的真实需求，提高康复效果。
items.titleZh: 当证据在现实生活中失效：重新思考运动损伤的康复与预防
items.summaryZh: 这篇述评批判性地审视了运动损伤预防与康复中传统的线性、还原论模型，主张采用整合的、复杂性导向的框架，该框架结合了动态的生物心理社会思维和对循证实践的全面解读，以提升以患者为中心的护理。
items.curatedReasonEn: Traditional linear, reductionist approaches to sports injury rehab and prevention have limitations. Start incorporating complexity science, a dynamic biopsychosocial model, and an integrative evidence-based practice framework into your clinical decisions to better adapt to athletes' real-world needs and improve outcomes.

items.title: Physical dependence, self-efficacy, and resilience in stroke patients: a double-moderated mediation model of healthcare group and pre-stroke employment.
items.summary: A cross-sectional study (N=123) found physical dependence was concurrently associated with lower resilience in stroke patients, partially mediated by self-efficacy. This conditional indirect pathway was significant among patients receiving routine care who were unemployed pre-stroke.
items.curatedReason: 这项观察性研究提示，卒中患者的身体依赖性可能与韧性（resilience）下降有关，其中自我效能感是部分中介因素。尤其关注那些卒中前失业且接受常规护理的患者；他们可能更需要支持，才能更好地适应卒中后的生活。
items.titleZh: 卒中患者的身体依赖性、自我效能和韧性：一项医疗组和卒中前就业状况双重调节的中介模型
items.summaryZh: 一项横断面研究（N=123）发现，卒中患者的身体依赖性与较低的韧性同时相关，其中自我效能感是部分中介因素。这种有条件的间接路径在接受常规护理且卒中前失业的患者中尤为显著。
items.curatedReasonEn: This observational study suggests that physical dependence in stroke patients may be linked to lower resilience, partially mediated by self-efficacy. Pay particular attention to patients who were unemployed pre-stroke and receiving routine care; they may need more support to adapt to life after stroke.
items.limitation: 这是一项横断面研究，无法建立因果关系，且样本量较小。
items.limitationEn: This is a cross-sectional study, which precludes causal inference, and involved a relatively small sample size.

items.title: Effect of Sequential Electroacupuncture Combined With Augmented Reality Gait Training on Walking Function and Neuromuscular Control in Subacute Stroke: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
items.summary: A 4-week randomized controlled trial (n=40) in subacute stroke patients found that sequential electroacupuncture combined with augmented reality gait training significantly improved gait speed (P=0.011), stride length, gait symmetry, motor function, and balance compared to augmented reality alone.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 提示，对于亚急性卒中患者，在增强现实步态训练前进行序贯电针治疗，能显著改善步速、步幅、步态对称性、运动功能和平衡。可以考虑将其作为现有 AR 步态训练的增效手段，但需留意其机制尚待进一步研究。
items.titleZh: 序贯电针联合增强现实步态训练对亚急性卒中患者步行功能和神经肌肉控制的影响：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 40 名亚急性卒中患者的 4 周随机对照试验发现，序贯电针联合增强现实步态训练显著改善了步速（P=0.011）、步幅、步态对称性、运动功能和平衡，优于单独的增强现实训练。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT suggests that sequential electroacupuncture prior to augmented reality gait training significantly improves gait speed, stride length, symmetry, motor function, and balance in subacute stroke patients. Consider this as an augmenting strategy for existing AR gait training, while noting its mechanisms require further investigation.
items.limitation: 本研究为单盲设计，且样本量相对较小（n=40），结果推广需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: This study used a single-blind design and had a relatively small sample size (n=40), so the generalizability of the findings should be interpreted with caution.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: Quantitative evaluation of shoulder motor compensation in stroke patients based on multimodal feature analysis.
items.summary: A study with 25 stroke patients demonstrated that integrating markerless motion capture with sEMG provides objective metrics for shoulder motor compensation, with maximum joint angle (ρ = 0.932, p < 0.001) and median frequency of sEMG (ρ = 0.806, p < 0.001) showing strong correlations with clinical scores.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究提出了一种基于无标记运动捕捉和表面肌电图的肩部运动代偿量化评估方法。如果你正在探索更客观、简化的卒中上肢功能评估工具，这为补充传统主观量表提供了一个有前景的思路。
items.titleZh: 基于多模态特征分析的卒中患者肩部运动代偿定量评估
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 25 名卒中患者的研究表明，结合无标记运动捕捉和表面肌电图能提供肩部运动代偿的客观指标，最大关节角度（ρ = 0.932, p < 0.001）和肌电图中位频率（ρ = 0.806, p < 0.001）与临床评分强相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study presents a quantitative method for assessing shoulder motor compensation using markerless motion capture and sEMG. If you're exploring more objective, simplified tools for upper limb function in stroke, this offers a promising approach to complement traditional subjective scales.
items.limitation: 本研究为观察性设计，仅在特定任务中评估了肩部功能，且样本量较小（n=25），外推性受限。
items.limitationEn: This observational study evaluated shoulder function only during a specific task with a small sample size (n=25), limiting generalizability.
items.journal: Journal of electromyography and kinesiology : official journal of the International Society of Electrophysiological Kinesiology

items.title: Addressing stroke family caregivers' mental health through person‑ and family‑centred rehabilitation.
items.summary: This review highlights that stroke family caregivers are at increased risk for adverse mental health outcomes and suggests that person- and family-centred care (PFCC) is a promising approach to integrate caregiver support into rehabilitation, recognizing them as key team members.
items.curatedReason: 卒中家庭照护者面临显著的精神健康风险。本综述强调了以人为本和以家庭为中心（PFCC）的康复模式在支持照护者方面的潜力。它提醒你，在卒中康复中，应将照护者视为康复团队的关键成员，并定期评估他们的需求，提供持续的教育、培训和支持。
items.titleZh: 通过以人为本和以家庭为中心的康复解决卒中家庭照护者的心理健康问题
items.summaryZh: 本综述指出卒中家庭照护者面临精神健康风险，并提出以人为本和以家庭为中心（PFCC）的康复模式，能将照护者作为关键团队成员纳入康复过程，有望改善其心理健康和福祉。
items.curatedReasonEn: Stroke family caregivers face significant mental health risks. This review highlights the potential of Person- and Family-Centred Care (PFCC) in supporting caregivers. It reminds you to recognize caregivers as key rehabilitation team members in stroke care, regularly assess their needs, and provide ongoing education, training, and support.
items.limitation: 本研究为叙述性综述，缺乏系统性评估和数据合成，结论主要基于文献论证。
items.limitationEn: This narrative review lacks systematic appraisal and data synthesis, with conclusions primarily based on literature argumentation.

items.title: Adaptive Sports Introduction During Inpatient Rehabilitation: A Descriptive Study.
items.summary: A cross-sectional study of 100 inpatients with new disabilities found that 43% desired exposure to adaptive sports during their admission, with younger age and pre-admission sports participation positively correlating with this desire.
items.curatedReason: 新发残疾患者对住院期间接触适应性运动有强烈兴趣。这对你的团队有启发：应考虑在早期康复阶段提供适应性运动介绍，并由多学科团队成员共同推进，以提高参与度。
items.titleZh: 住院康复期间适应性运动的引入：一项描述性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 100 名新发残疾住院患者的横断面研究发现，43% 的患者希望在住院期间接触适应性运动，其中年龄较轻和入院前有运动参与者对此意愿更强。
items.curatedReasonEn: Patients with new disabilities show significant interest in adaptive sports during inpatient rehabilitation. This suggests that your team should consider integrating adaptive sports introductions early in rehabilitation, leveraging a multidisciplinary approach to optimize exposure and participation.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面描述性设计，仅能提示相关性，无法确立因果关系。
items.limitationEn: This cross-sectional descriptive study can only suggest correlations, not establish causality.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: Study Protocol for a Randomized Controlled Trial Comparing Swiss Ball Balance Training and Conventional Balance Training to Improve Trunk Control and Mobility in Individuals with Sub acute Stroke.
items.summary: This study protocol describes a randomized, assessor-blinded, crossover trial to compare the effects of 6-week Swiss ball balance training versus conventional balance training on trunk control, balance, and mobility in individuals with subacute stroke in Sub-Saharan Africa.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 方案旨在比较瑞士球平衡训练与传统平衡训练对亚急性卒中患者躯干控制、平衡和活动能力的影响。在正式结果公布前，值得我们思考如何在卒中康复中引入动态且需要核心参与的训练，但请记住，这目前仍停留在方案阶段。
items.titleZh: 一项比较瑞士球平衡训练与传统平衡训练以改善亚急性卒中患者躯干控制和活动能力的随机对照试验研究方案
items.summaryZh: 本研究方案描述了一项随机、评估者设盲、交叉试验，旨在比较为期 6 周的瑞士球平衡训练与传统平衡训练对撒哈拉以南非洲亚急性卒中患者躯干控制、平衡和活动能力的影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT protocol will compare Swiss ball balance training with conventional balance training for trunk control, balance, and mobility in subacute stroke. Before the definitive results are published, consider how dynamic, core-engaging exercises might integrate into stroke rehab, but remember, this is currently just a protocol.

items.title: CMS Adds Medicare Options to Help People Manage Substance Use Disorder, Heart Failure, and Other Common Chronic Conditions
items.summary: CMS is expanding its Advancing Chronic Care with Effective, Scalable Solutions (ACCESS) Model to include technology-supported care options for Medicare beneficiaries with heart failure, COPD, substance use disorders, nicotine dependence, and expanded support for chronic musculoskeletal pain, starting in spring 2027. The model ties payments to measurable improvements in patient health.
items.curatedReason: 从 2027 年春季开始，美国 CMS 将通过 ACCESS 模型扩展对心力衰竭、COPD、物质使用障碍及慢性肌肉骨骼疼痛患者的 Medicare 远程护理选项。这意味着你在这些领域为 Medicare 患者提供基于技术的居家康复服务将有新的报销途径，密切关注实施细则，这会影响你未来的服务模式和收入。
items.titleZh: CMS 增加 Medicare 选项以帮助患者管理物质使用障碍、心力衰竭及其他常见慢性病
items.summaryZh: CMS 将通过其“推进慢性病有效可扩展解决方案（ACCESS）”模型，扩展对 Medicare 受益人的技术支持护理选项，涵盖心力衰竭、COPD、物质使用障碍、尼古丁依赖以及慢性肌肉骨骼疼痛的扩展支持，预计于 2027 年春季启动。该模型将支付与患者健康的可衡量改善挂钩。
items.curatedReasonEn: Starting in spring 2027, CMS will expand Medicare's technology-supported home care options for patients with heart failure, COPD, substance use disorder, and chronic musculoskeletal pain through the ACCESS Model. This implies new reimbursement avenues for you to provide technology-enabled home rehabilitation services to Medicare patients in these areas. Closely monitor implementation details, as this will impact your future service models and revenue.

items.title:
Associations between interpreter dependency and rehabilitation outcomes and care processes following acquired brain injury: a Swedish registry-based cohort study
							| Journal of Rehabilitation Medicine
items.summary: A Swedish registry-based cohort study of 13,900 inpatients with acquired brain injury found that interpreter dependency was associated with lower functional independence, health-related quality of life, and self-perceived health scores at admission and discharge, though not with the degree of improvement.
items.curatedReason: 语言障碍是脑损伤康复中被忽视的关键因素。该研究表明，口译依赖型患者在功能独立性、生活质量和自我感知健康方面表现更差，提示在制定康复计划时，除了临床因素，还应考虑患者的语言支持需求。
items.titleZh: 口译依赖与脑损伤康复结果及护理过程的关联：一项瑞典注册回顾性队列研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对 13,900 名脑损伤住院患者进行的瑞典注册回顾性队列研究发现，口译依赖与入院及出院时较低的功能独立性、健康相关生活质量和自我感知健康评分相关，但与这些结果的改善程度无关。
items.curatedReasonEn: Language barriers are a critical yet often overlooked factor in brain injury rehabilitation. This study indicates that interpreter-dependent patients experience poorer outcomes in functional independence, quality of life, and self-perceived health, suggesting that rehabilitation planning should integrate language support needs alongside clinical factors.
items.limitation: 这项回顾性队列研究可能存在未测量混杂因素（如脑损伤严重程度或早期护理差异）的影响。
items.limitationEn: This retrospective cohort study may be influenced by unmeasured confounders, such as injury severity or disparities in earlier care.

items.title: Cost-utility of non-pharmacologic interventions aimed at improving cognitive outcomes after traumatic brain injury in older adulthood from the Ontario public healthcare payer perspective
items.summary: A cost-utility analysis in Ontario, Canada, found that combination therapy (physical rehabilitation and cognitive training) yielded the highest quality-adjusted life years (3.04 QALYs) and net monetary benefits (CAD$102,653) for improving cognitive outcomes in older adults (≥ 65 years) following traumatic brain injury, with an ICER of CAD$18,028 per QALY.
items.curatedReason: 对老年创伤性脑损伤（TBI）患者来说，物理康复联合认知训练是改善认知结局最具成本效益的非药物干预措施。这为你在向安大略省的支付方推介 TBI 老年患者的综合康复方案时，提供了强有力的经济学证据支持。
items.titleZh: 从安大略省公共医疗支付方角度看，旨在改善老年创伤性脑损伤认知结局的非药物干预措施的成本效益
items.summaryZh: 一项针对加拿大安大略省的成本效益分析发现，对于老年（≥ 65 岁）创伤性脑损伤患者，物理康复与认知训练的联合疗法在改善认知结局方面产生了最高的质量调整生命年（3.04 QALYs）和净货币收益（102,653 加元），增量成本效益比为 18,028 加元/QALY。
items.curatedReasonEn: For older adults with traumatic brain injury (TBI), combined physical rehabilitation and cognitive training is the most cost-effective non-pharmacologic intervention to improve cognitive outcomes. This provides strong economic evidence to support your advocacy for integrated rehabilitation programs for older TBI patients when dealing with payers in Ontario.
items.limitation: 本研究为成本效益分析，其结果依赖于模型假设和输入参数，可能与现实世界数据存在偏差。
items.limitationEn: This cost-utility analysis relies on model assumptions and input parameters, which may differ from real-world data.

items.title: The effects of an enriched tennis program on the executive functions and motor skills of preschool children
items.summary: An 8-week enriched tennis program featuring open-skill activities significantly improved inhibitory control (p = .008, ηp2 = .184) and tennis-specific motor skills (forehand p = .001, ηp2 = .259; ball control p = .006, ηp2 = .200) in preschool children, compared to a control group with closed-skill activities.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 显示，为期 8 周的开放技能网球课程能有效改善学龄前儿童的抑制性控制和网球专项运动技能。这提示你在早期干预中，融入这类强调认知参与的动态开放技能活动，有助于提升儿童的运动与认知发展。
items.titleZh: 丰富网球课程对学龄前儿童执行功能和运动技能的影响
items.summaryZh: 一项为期 8 周的丰富网球课程（包含开放技能活动）显著改善了学龄前儿童的抑制性控制（p = .008, ηp2 = .184）和网球专项运动技能（正手 p = .001, ηp2 = .259；控球 p = .006, ηp2 = .200），相较于仅进行封闭技能活动的对照组。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT demonstrates that an 8-week open-skill tennis program can effectively improve inhibitory control and tennis-specific motor skills in preschool children. This suggests that incorporating dynamic, open-skill activities that emphasize cognitive engagement into early interventions can enhance children's motor and cognitive development.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小，且干预组和对照组在年龄上存在微小差异。
items.limitationEn: The study has a small sample size, and there was a minor age difference between the intervention and control groups.

items.title: Exercise snacking as a novel strategy for prevention and intervention of frailty in older adults: a scoping review
items.summary: A scoping review of 16 studies found that "exercise snacking" is a safe and promising strategy for frailty prevention and intervention in older adults, improving physical function (muscle strength, balance, mobility) and adherence, with most studies being (pilot) RCTs published since 2022.
items.curatedReason: 这项范围综述确认，碎片化运动（“运动零食”）是老年人衰弱预防和干预的安全有效策略，对提高身体功能、依从性有积极作用。这为你将碎片化运动纳入老年患者的个性化康复计划提供了高等级证据，尤其适用于传统长时间运动受限的患者。
items.titleZh: 碎片化运动作为老年人衰弱预防与干预的新策略：一项范围综述
items.summaryZh: 一项对 16 项研究进行的范围综述发现，碎片化运动（“运动零食”）是老年人衰弱预防和干预的一种安全且有前景的策略，能改善身体功能（肌肉力量、平衡、活动能力）和依从性，其中大多数研究为自 2022 年以来发表的（初步）随机对照试验。
items.curatedReasonEn: This scoping review confirms that "exercise snacking" is a safe and effective strategy for frailty prevention and intervention in older adults, positively impacting physical function and adherence. This provides high-level evidence for integrating exercise snacking into individualized rehabilitation plans for older patients, especially those limited by traditional long-duration exercise.
items.limitation: 纳入研究的设计类型多样（多数为 RCTs），但仍需大规模多中心试验来验证个体化方案的有效性。
items.limitationEn: Although most included studies are RCTs, large-scale multicenter trials are still needed to validate individualized exercise snacking regimens.

items.title: Two-year follow-up of varus progression in young professional football players
items.summary: A two-year follow-up study of 31 adolescent male professional academy football players found that varus progression (increase in mechanical femorotibial axis angle, MAA) was most pronounced in younger athletes and significantly associated with greater increases in height, low initial height, BMI, and less initial varus deformity.
items.curatedReason: 这项针对青少年足球运动员的两年随访研究提示，股胫机械轴角度（MAA）的增加在年轻运动员中更为显著，且与身高和体重增长相关。在制定青少年足球运动员预防方案时，应特别关注生长发育期，早期识别并管理膝内翻风险。
items.titleZh: 青少年职业足球运动员膝内翻进展的两年随访研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对 31 名青少年职业足球运动员的两年随访研究发现，膝内翻进展（股胫机械轴角度增加）在年龄较小的运动员中最为显著，并与身高、初始身高较低、BMI 和初始膝内翻畸形程度较轻的更大增幅显著相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This two-year follow-up study on young football players suggests that an increase in the mechanical femorotibial axis angle (MAA) is more pronounced in younger athletes and associated with growth in height and weight. When developing preventive strategies for youth football players, prioritize monitoring during growth spurts to identify and manage genu varum risk early.
items.limitation: 本研究为小样本观察性队列，且入组球员均为在观察期内出现膝内翻进展的特定队列，结果外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This study is a small observational cohort of players specifically showing varus progression, limiting generalizability.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Evidence-Based Insights for the Development and Talent Promotion of Young Athletes in a National Sports Context
items.summary: This perspective article explores the challenges and opportunities in integrating early talent promotion with sustainable athlete development frameworks, using the Swedish context as a case study. It argues for a nuanced, evidence-based approach that supports both elite performance and broader participation goals, emphasizing athlete well-being and intrinsic motivation.
items.curatedReason: 这份述评基于瑞典的经验，强调了在国家体育背景下，青年运动员的发展与人才培养需要平衡早期精英选拔和长期、包容性发展模式。它提醒你，在推动运动康复和表现训练时，要考量当地文化和组织背景，并兼顾运动员的福祉和广泛参与。
items.titleZh: 在国家体育背景下，青年运动员发展与人才培养的循证见解
items.summaryZh: 这篇述评文章以瑞典为例，探讨了在整合早期人才培养与可持续运动员发展框架方面的挑战与机遇。文章认为，应采取一种细致入微的循证方法，同时支持精英表现和更广泛的参与目标，并强调运动员的福祉和内在动机。
items.curatedReasonEn: Drawing from the Swedish experience, this perspective emphasizes that youth athlete development and talent promotion within a national sports context require balancing early elite selection with long-term, inclusive development models. It reminds you to consider local cultural and organizational contexts and prioritize athlete well-being and broad participation when promoting sports rehabilitation and performance training.

items.title: Motor Module-Guided Human-Machine Interaction Promotes Improvement of Neuromuscular Coordination and Reduction in Motor Impairment in Chronic Stroke: A Pilot Study
items.summary: A pilot study with 5 chronic stroke survivors found that a 6-week motor module-guided intervention improved neuromuscular coordination and clinically meaningful motor impairment, which was maintained for up to 3 months. A control group (n=3) with force-guided intervention showed no significant changes in neuromuscular coordination or motor impairment.
items.curatedReason: 该初步研究提示，以运动模块（motor module）为导向的康复结合人机交互，可能改善慢性卒中患者的神经肌肉协调和运动障碍。这为传统卒中康复提供了新的思路，但仍需更大规模的 RCT 验证其临床转化潜力。
items.titleZh: 运动模块引导的人机交互促进慢性卒中患者神经肌肉协调性改善及运动障碍减轻：一项试点研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 5 名慢性卒中患者的试点研究发现，为期 6 周的运动模块引导干预改善了神经肌肉协调性和临床有意义的运动障碍，并维持长达 3 个月。而 3 名接受力引导干预的对照组患者在神经肌肉协调性或运动障碍方面未显示显著变化。
items.curatedReasonEn: This pilot study suggests that motor module-guided rehabilitation combined with human-machine interaction may improve neuromuscular coordination and motor impairment in chronic stroke survivors. This offers a new perspective for traditional stroke rehabilitation, but larger RCTs are needed to validate its clinical translation potential.
items.limitation: 这是一项小型试点研究，样本量非常有限（5 名实验组，3 名对照组），且缺乏随机化。
items.limitationEn: This is a small pilot study with a very limited sample size (5 in intervention group, 3 in control group) and lacks randomization.

items.title: Physical Exercise Reduces Fall-Related Outcomes Among People With Stroke: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 18 studies (1536 participants) found that physical exercise significantly reduced the number of falls by 39% (IRR = 0.61, 95% CI = [0.47, 0.78]) among people with stroke, with balance training and integrated cognitive components being most effective.
items.curatedReason: 物理锻炼能显著降低卒中患者的跌倒次数，尤其是平衡训练和结合认知成分的锻炼更有效。将这些发现整合到你的卒中康复方案中，特别是对慢性期和中度残疾的患者。
items.titleZh: 体育锻炼可减少卒中患者跌倒相关结局：一项系统综述和 Meta 分析
items.summaryZh: 一项包含 18 项研究（1536 名参与者）的系统综述和 Meta 分析显示，体育锻炼显著减少卒中患者的跌倒次数达 39% (IRR = 0.61)，其中平衡训练和整合认知成分的锻炼效果最佳。
items.curatedReasonEn: Physical exercise significantly reduces the number of falls in stroke patients, with balance training and exercises integrating cognitive components being particularly effective. Integrate these findings into your stroke rehabilitation protocols, especially for patients in the chronic stage with mild to moderate disability.
items.limitation: Meta 分析未区分不同运动类型的具体干预细节和剂量，可能影响结果的泛化性。
items.limitationEn: The meta-analysis did not differentiate the specific intervention details and dosages of various exercise types, which might affect the generalizability of the results.

items.title: Association Between Therapeutic Education Delivered by a Community Post-Stroke Rehabilitation Team and Improvement in the Frenchay Activities Index: A Retrospective Cohort Study.
items.summary: A retrospective cohort study (163 stroke survivors) found that home-based Therapeutic Patient Education (TPE) delivered by a Community Stroke Rehabilitation Team was associated with greater improvement in Frenchay Activities Index scores (mean change: 6.02 vs. 1.62, p < 0.001), particularly when combined with physical activity workshops.
items.curatedReason: 社区卒中康复团队提供的居家治疗性患者教育（TPE）与卒中后社会参与度提升相关，尤其在结合体育活动工作坊时效果更佳。这提示你在设计居家康复计划时，应积极考虑整合 TPE 和体育活动指导。
items.titleZh: 社区卒中康复团队提供的治疗性教育与 Frenchay 活动指数改善之间的关联：一项回顾性队列研究
items.summaryZh: 一项回顾性队列研究（163 名卒中幸存者）发现，社区卒中康复团队提供的居家治疗性患者教育与 Frenchay 活动指数的显著改善相关（平均变化：6.02 vs. 1.62），尤其在结合体育活动工作坊时效果更佳。
items.curatedReasonEn: Home-based Therapeutic Patient Education (TPE) delivered by Community Stroke Rehabilitation Teams is associated with improved social participation post-stroke, especially when combined with physical activity workshops. This suggests you should actively consider integrating TPE and physical activity guidance when designing home rehabilitation programs.
items.limitation: 回顾性队列研究设计无法建立因果关系，且可能存在未测量混杂因素。
items.limitationEn: The retrospective cohort study design cannot establish causality and may be subject to unmeasured confounding factors.

items.title: Adding the short, digital PainSMART-educational strategy whilst patients with musculoskeletal pain wait for primary care physiotherapy: A randomised controlled trial.
items.summary: Adding a 7-minute digital pain science education strategy (PainSMART) to usual physiotherapy for musculoskeletal pain did not result in additional clinically meaningful benefits once physiotherapy had commenced, though it showed earlier improvements in self-efficacy for some patients during waiting times.
items.curatedReason: 等待初级诊疗物理治疗期间，数字化的疼痛科学教育可能对部分患者有益，但一旦正式物理治疗开始，其附加的临床意义并不显著。在常规诊疗方案中，不必强求加入该策略。
items.titleZh: 初级诊疗物理治疗等待期间，联合短期数字化疼痛科学教育策略（PainSMART）对肌肉骨骼疼痛患者的随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项多中心随机对照试验显示，在常规物理治疗中增加 7 分钟的数字化疼痛科学教育（PainSMART）对肌肉骨骼疼痛患者的临床益处不显著，尽管在等待期间部分患者的疼痛自效能有所改善。
items.curatedReasonEn: While a digital pain science education strategy might benefit some patients during the wait for primary care physiotherapy, its added clinical benefit is not significant once formal physiotherapy begins. There's no strong imperative to integrate this strategy into routine management.
items.limitation: 研究未详细报告疼痛自效能的完整分析结果，可能存在选择性报告。
items.limitationEn: The study did not fully report the complete analysis results for pain self-efficacy, suggesting potential selective reporting.

items.title: If ACL injury is multifactorial, why is return-to-sport testing not? A determinant-alignment framework for ACL rehabilitation and return to sport.
items.summary: This Masterclass proposes a determinant-alignment framework for late-stage rehabilitation and return-to-sport (RTS) assessment after ACL injury, advocating for a broader integration of tests, movement behavior, psychological readiness, exposure progression, and sport context beyond traditional physical capacity measures.
items.curatedReason: ACL 损伤后重返运动（RTS）测试不应只聚焦于体能，还需更全面地评估感知、神经认知、情境和代表性运动需求。使用提出的行列式对齐框架来识别评估中的潜在差距，以实现更全面的康复和 RTS 决策。
items.titleZh: 既然 ACL 损伤是多因素的，为什么重返运动测试不是？ACL 康复和重返运动的决定因素对齐框架
items.summaryZh: 本篇大师班文章提出了一种 ACL 损伤后期康复和重返运动（RTS）评估的决定因素对齐框架，主张在传统体能测量之外，更广泛地整合测试、运动行为、心理准备、暴露进展和运动情境。
items.curatedReasonEn: Return-to-sport (RTS) testing after ACL injury should not only focus on physical capacity but also comprehensively assess perceptual, neurocognitive, contextual, and representative sport demands. Use the proposed determinant-alignment framework to identify potential gaps in your assessment for a more holistic rehabilitation and RTS decision-making.
items.limitation: 本框架为假设生成式的临床启发法，而非经过验证的分类法或预测算法，其对降低再次 ACL 损伤的有效性尚未有证据支持。
items.limitationEn: This framework is a hypothesis-generating clinical heuristic, not a validated taxonomy or prediction algorithm, and there is no evidence yet to support its effectiveness in reducing second ACL injuries.
items.journal: Physical therapy in sport : official journal of the Association of Chartered Physiotherapists in Sports Medicine

items.title: Leader and Follower Roles in Adapted Tango Reveal Complementary Neural Routes to Motor Improvement in Parkinson's Disease
items.summary: A 12-week randomized controlled trial found that adapted tango, in both Leader and Follower roles, significantly improved overall disease severity and motor impairment in people with mild-to-moderate Parkinson's disease, compared to a control group, suggesting complementary neural routes to motor improvement.
items.curatedReason: 这项随机对照研究提供了强证据，表明适应性探戈（无论是主导还是跟随角色）都能改善帕金森病患者的运动功能和整体疾病严重程度，且可能通过不同的神经通路起作用。在临床实践中，可以考虑将舞蹈治疗，特别是适应性探戈，作为帕金森病康复的有效辅助手段。
items.titleZh: 适应性探戈中的主导者和跟随者角色揭示了帕金森病运动改善的互补神经通路
items.summaryZh: 一项为期 12 周的随机对照试验发现，与对照组相比，轻中度帕金森病患者在适应性探戈中扮演主导者和跟随者角色均显著改善了整体疾病严重程度和运动障碍，这表明运动改善可能通过互补的神经通路实现。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT provides strong evidence that adapted tango, in both leader and follower roles, can improve motor function and overall disease severity in Parkinson's disease, potentially through distinct neural pathways. Clinically, consider dance therapy, particularly adapted tango, as an effective adjunct in Parkinson's rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 研究样本量相对较小，且仅限于轻中度帕金森病患者，结果在更广泛人群中的普适性有待进一步验证。
items.limitationEn: The study's sample size is relatively small and limited to individuals with mild-to-moderate Parkinson's disease, so the generalizability of the findings to a broader population requires further validation.

items.title: Feasibility and efficacy of personalized cardiorespiratory and strength exercise in Duchenne muscular dystrophy: a pilot study
items.summary: A pilot study with six ambulatory boys with Duchenne muscular dystrophy (DMD) found that 6 months of home-based, remotely-supervised personalized leg cycling and isometric strengthening was feasible and safe, leading to improved peak VO2, submaximal-cycling HR, and increased hamstring strength.
items.curatedReason: 这项初步研究提示，在杜氏肌营养不良症 (DMD) 儿童中，个性化的心肺和力量训练是安全且可行的，可能带来多系统生理益处。在缺乏特定疾病指南的情况下，这为未来更大型研究和临床实践提供了方向，但仍需等待进一步的验证性研究。
items.titleZh: 个性化心肺和力量训练在杜氏肌营养不良症中的可行性和有效性：一项初步研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 6 名杜氏肌营养不良症 (DMD) 可行走男孩的初步研究发现，为期 6 个月的居家、远程监督的个性化腿部循环和等长力量训练是可行且安全的，并改善了峰值摄氧量、次最大循环心率和增加了踇肌力量。
items.curatedReasonEn: This pilot study suggests that personalized cardiorespiratory and strength exercise is safe and feasible for boys with Duchenne muscular dystrophy (DMD), potentially offering multisystem physiological benefits. While awaiting larger confirmatory studies, this provides direction for future research and clinical practice in the absence of disease-specific guidelines.
items.limitation: 这是一项小样本的初步研究（6 名参与者），缺乏长期随访数据，其功效需在更大规模的对照研究中进一步验证。
items.limitationEn: This is a pilot study with a small sample size (6 participants) and lacks long-term follow-up data; its efficacy requires further validation in larger controlled studies.

items.title: Sarcopenia, Nutritional Status, and the Association Between Rehabilitation Dose and Functional Efficiency After Inpatient Rehabilitation for First-Ever Ischemic Stroke.
items.summary: A single-center retrospective cohort of 1,036 ischemic stroke patients found that a higher rehabilitation dose (β=0.17), better nutritional status (β=0.05), and absence of sarcopenia (β=-0.22) were associated with improved functional efficiency. Sarcopenia negatively interacted with rehabilitation dose (β=-0.12).
items.curatedReason: 这项回顾性研究证实，卒中后康复中的康复剂量、肌少症和营养状况都会影响患者的功能效率。肌少症患者可能需要更高的康复剂量以抵消其负面影响。
items.titleZh: 首次缺血性卒中住院康复后，肌少症、营养状况与康复剂量和功能效率之间的关联
items.summaryZh: 一项对 1036 名首次缺血性卒中患者进行的回顾性队列研究发现，更高的康复剂量 (β=0.17)、更好的营养状况 (β=0.05) 和无肌少症 (β=-0.22) 与更高的功能效率相关。肌少症与康复剂量呈负向交互作用 (β=-0.12)。
items.curatedReasonEn: This retrospective study confirms that rehabilitation dose, sarcopenia, and nutritional status all impact functional efficiency after stroke rehabilitation. Patients with sarcopenia may require a higher rehabilitation dose to offset its negative effects.
items.limitation: 这是一项单中心回顾性队列研究，可能存在选择偏倚和混杂因素，结果的外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This was a single-center retrospective cohort study, which may have selection bias and confounding factors, limiting the generalizability of the results.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: Therapists' perspectives on the use of an overground lower-limb exoskeleton in physiotherapy sessions for minimally ambulatory children with cerebral palsy: a qualitative study
items.summary: A qualitative study exploring the perspectives of 9 physiotherapists on using overground lower-limb exoskeletons with minimally ambulatory children (n=10) with cerebral palsy found exoskeletons provide additional exercise options, enhance inclusion and autonomy, but require new clinical skills and resources.
items.curatedReason: 对于那些考虑在脑瘫儿童（尤其是只有最基本活动能力的患儿）中使用下肢外骨骼的治疗师，这份针对 9 名 PT 的定性研究提示，外骨骼确实能增加额外的运动选项、提升患儿的参与感和自主性。但别忘了，它同时也意味着你需要掌握新的临床技能，并投入更多资源，所以做决策前，请务必全面评估你的科室配置和支持系统。
items.titleZh: 治疗师对在脑瘫患儿物理治疗中使用地面下肢外骨骼的看法：一项定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项定性研究探讨了 9 名物理治疗师对在低活动度脑瘫儿童（10 名）物理治疗中使用地面下肢外骨骼的看法，发现外骨骼提供了额外的运动选择，增强了患儿的参与感和自主性，但需要新的临床技能和资源。
items.curatedReasonEn: For therapists considering overground lower-limb exoskeletons with minimally ambulatory children with cerebral palsy, this qualitative study of 9 PTs suggests exoskeletons do offer additional exercise options, enhance inclusion, and foster autonomy. However, be mindful that integrating this technology also demands new clinical skills and resource allocation. Before committing, thoroughly assess your department's readiness and support systems.
items.limitation: 这是一项定性研究，样本量较小（9 名治疗师），且结果依赖于治疗师的主观感知，可能存在解释偏倚，普适性有限。
items.limitationEn: This is a qualitative study with a small sample size (9 therapists), and the findings rely on therapists' subjective perceptions, which may introduce interpretation bias and limit generalizability.

items.title: Biological effects of technique-specific manual therapy in healthy individuals and people with musculoskeletal disorders: a systematic review with meta-analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis (50 studies, 2,147 participants) found that manual therapy (MT) is associated with short-term modulation of neurophysiological regulation, with technique-specific response profiles. Joint mobilization primarily induces sympathetic-driven responses (increased skin conductance), while soft tissue techniques are more frequently associated with parasympathetic-driven markers (reduced heart rate, increased RMSSD).
items.curatedReason: 手法治疗（MT）并非万金油，其神经生理学效应是技术特异性的：关节松动术主要引起交感神经反应，而软组织技术则更常与副交感神经活动相关。在选择手法时，你可以依据这些发现，更精准地匹配患者的神经生理状态和预期效果。
items.titleZh: 技术特异性手法治疗对健康个体及肌肉骨骼疾病患者的生物学效应：系统综述与荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述和荟萃分析（50 项研究，2147 名参与者）发现，手法治疗（MT）与神经生理调节的短期调节相关，并具有技术特异性的反应谱。关节松动术主要引起交感神经驱动的反应（皮肤电导增加），而软组织技术则更常与副交感神经驱动的标志物（心率降低，RMSSD 增加）相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: Manual therapy (MT) is not a one-size-fits-all solution; its neurophysiological effects are technique-specific. Joint mobilization primarily elicits sympathetic responses, whereas soft tissue techniques are more frequently associated with parasympathetic activity. When choosing a technique, you can use these findings to more precisely match the patient's neurophysiological state and desired outcome.
items.limitation: 由于研究方法学异质性和不精确性，证据的总体确定性为低到中等，尚需更高质量的统一研究进一步验证。
items.limitationEn: The overall certainty of evidence ranged from low to moderate due to methodological heterogeneity and imprecision, requiring further validation from higher-quality, uniform studies.
items.journal: The Journal of manual & manipulative therapy

items.title: Implementation of group-based health education and exercise for individuals with knee osteoarthritis in brazilian primary health care: a mixed-methods study.
items.summary: A mixed-methods implementation study of a physical therapist-led, group-based exercise and education program for knee osteoarthritis in Brazilian primary health care found high recruitment (87.3%), retention (83%), and adherence, with participants missing an average of 1.39 sessions. The program was feasible, well-accepted, and showed exploratory clinical improvements in pain and function.
items.curatedReason: 在低/中收入国家，将基于团体的膝骨关节炎运动和教育计划整合进初级保健是可行且广受欢迎的。这项研究展示了高招募率和依从性，提示该模式可有效提高此类地区的干预可及性。
items.titleZh: 巴西初级卫生保健中针对膝骨关节炎患者的团体健康教育和运动实施：一项混合方法研究
items.summaryZh: 一项在巴西初级卫生保健中进行的混合方法实施研究显示，由物理治疗师主导的团体运动和健康教育项目针对膝骨关节炎患者具有高度可行性和可接受性。该项目招募率达 87.3%，留存率 83%，依从性高，平均仅缺席 1.39 次，并初步显示疼痛和功能改善。
items.curatedReasonEn: Integrating group-based exercise and education programs for knee osteoarthritis into primary care is feasible and well-received in low- and middle-income countries. This study demonstrates high recruitment and adherence, suggesting this model can effectively improve access to interventions in these regions.
items.limitation: 研究对象来自巴西，其结果在外推至其他文化和医疗系统时需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: The study's findings, derived from a Brazilian context, should be interpreted with caution when generalizing to other cultural and healthcare systems.

items.title: Developing biopsychosocial competence in musculoskeletal pain care: Australian physiotherapy educators' perspectives.
items.summary: A qualitative study explored 18 Australian physiotherapy educators' perspectives on translating the biopsychosocial approach to musculoskeletal pain care. Five themes were identified, detailing 'levers to biopsychosocial translation' across different training levels, theoretical models, skill development, learning enablers, and clinical adoption support.
items.curatedReason: 这份研究提示我们，在疼痛护理中加强生物心理社会（BPS）能力，需要关注不同培训阶段的理论模型、技能发展、学习支持和临床采纳障碍。评估你的教学或临床转化策略时，不妨对照这 5 个主题自查。
items.titleZh: 培养肌肉骨骼疼痛护理中的生物心理社会能力：澳大利亚物理治疗教育者的视角
items.summaryZh: 一项定性研究探讨了 18 位澳大利亚物理治疗教育者对将生物心理社会方法应用于肌肉骨骼疼痛护理的看法。研究确定了五个主题，详细阐述了在不同培训水平、理论模型、技能发展、学习促进因素和临床采纳支持方面的“生物心理社会转化杠杆”。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study suggests that strengthening biopsychosocial (BPS) competencies in pain care requires attention to theoretical models, skill development, learning enablers, and clinical adoption barriers across different training levels. When evaluating your teaching or clinical translation strategies, consider using these five themes as a self-assessment tool.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性研究，结果基于教育者的主观叙述，而非实际教学效果的量化评估。
items.limitationEn: This is a qualitative study, and its findings are based on educators' subjective narratives rather than quantitative evaluations of actual teaching effectiveness.

items.title: Comparison of action observation therapy and virtual reality combined with conventional therapy for upper extremity rehabilitation in children with unilateral cerebral palsy.
items.summary: A randomized clinical trial with 45 children (5-15 years) with Unilateral Cerebral Palsy found that both Action Observation Therapy (AOT) and XBOX 360 Kinect™, when combined with conventional physiotherapy, significantly improved upper extremity function. AOT showed more comprehensive gains across grasp types and selectivity, while XBOX mainly improved pinch, lateral grip, and forearm selectivity.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 表明，在常规物理治疗基础上，观察动作疗法（AOT）和虚拟现实（XBOX）均能有效改善单侧脑瘫儿童的上肢功能，其中 AOT 在抓握类型和选择性方面效果更全面，为临床实践提供了新的辅助治疗选择。
items.titleZh: 动作观察疗法和虚拟现实结合常规疗法对单侧脑瘫儿童上肢康复的比较研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对 45 名单侧脑瘫儿童（5-15 岁）进行的随机临床试验发现，动作观察疗法（AOT）和 XBOX 360 Kinect™ 结合常规物理治疗，均能显著改善上肢功能。AOT 在各种抓握类型和选择性方面显示出更全面的改善，而 XBOX 主要改善了捏握、侧向握持和前臂选择性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT indicates that both Action Observation Therapy (AOT) and virtual reality (XBOX), when combined with conventional physiotherapy, effectively improve upper extremity function in children with unilateral cerebral palsy. AOT showed more comprehensive gains in grasp types and selectivity, offering new adjunctive therapy options for clinical practice.
items.limitation: 研究观察期较短（3 周），其长期效果和对不同脑瘫严重程度儿童的适用性尚不明确。
items.limitationEn: The study's observation period was short (3 weeks), and its long-term effects and applicability to children with varying severities of cerebral palsy remain unclear.

items.title: Scar dry needling for tissue compliance in individuals with linear scars: a randomized controlled trial.
items.summary: A single-center, assessor-blinded randomized controlled trial (n=80) compared scar dry needling (scar-DN) with minimal needling for linear scars. Scar-DN was associated with greater tissue compliance at 5-mm and 10-mm indentation depths immediately post-treatment and at 10-mm and 15-mm depths at follow-up. No significant differences were found in scar-related pain or health-related quality of life.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 提示，疤痕干针治疗（scar-DN）能短期改善疤痕组织的顺应性，但对局部疤痕相关疼痛或生活质量无显著影响。在将此技术纳入常规实践前，应谨慎评估其临床重要性和持久性。
items.titleZh: 疤痕干针治疗对线性疤痕患者组织顺应性的影响：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项单中心、评估者设盲的随机对照试验（n=80）比较了疤痕干针治疗（scar-DN）与微创针刺对线性疤痕的影响。结果显示，scar-DN 在治疗后即刻和随访时，在 5 毫米和 10 毫米压痕深度处均与更高的组织顺应性相关。在疤痕相关疼痛或健康相关生活质量方面未发现显著差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT suggests that scar dry needling (scar-DN) can short-term improve scar tissue compliance, but has no significant effect on local scar-related pain or quality of life. Before incorporating this technique into routine practice, its clinical importance and durability should be carefully evaluated.
items.limitation: 研究对局部疤痕疼痛的分析能力不足，且生活质量和被动膝关节屈曲无显著改善，限制了其临床重要性。
items.limitationEn: The study was underpowered for analyzing local scar-related pain, and no significant improvements were found in quality of life or passive knee flexion, limiting its clinical significance.
items.journal: The Journal of manual & manipulative therapy

items.title: Proprioception Training and Surrogate Outcomes: A Systematic Review of Definitions, Measures, and Effectiveness Claims.
items.summary: A systematic review (51 RCTs, n=2319) on proprioception training found that improvements inferred from surrogate outcomes (balance, strength, pain) were more frequent and larger than those observed in direct psychophysical measures. Specific, attentionally demanding training targeting measured proprioceptive submodality produced the most consistent benefits in position-reproduction accuracy, movement-detection sensitivity, or discrimination performance.
items.curatedReason: 这份系统综述强调，本体感觉训练的临床效果常被替代结局指标（如平衡、力量、疼痛）夸大。要真正改善本体感觉功能，训练必须明确靶向特定感觉维度，并且测量工具与干预内容需高度匹配。这提示你在评估和设计本体感觉训练时，应优先使用直接的心理物理学测量，避免被通用运动适应性指标误导。
items.titleZh: 本体感觉训练与替代结局指标：定义、测量和有效性主张的系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项关于本体感觉训练的系统综述（51 项随机对照试验，n=2319）发现，从替代结局指标（平衡、力量、疼痛）推断出的改善比直接心理物理学测量观察到的改善更常见且幅度更大。特定、需要注意力的训练，如果针对测量的本体感觉子模态，能在位置再现准确性、运动检测敏感性或辨别能力方面产生最一致的益处。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review highlights that the clinical effects of proprioception training are often exaggerated by surrogate outcomes (e.g., balance, strength, pain). To genuinely improve proprioceptive function, training must explicitly target specific sensory dimensions, and measurement tools must align closely with the intervention content. This suggests that when evaluating and designing proprioception training, you should prioritize direct psychophysical measures and avoid being misled by generic motor adaptation metrics.
items.limitation: 本综述包含的研究存在异质性，对本体感觉的定义和测量方法不统一，这影响了结果的综合和结论的确定性。
items.limitationEn: The included studies in this review were heterogeneous, with inconsistent definitions and measurement methods for proprioception, affecting the synthesis of results and the certainty of conclusions.

items.title: Effects of a Cycling-Based Aerobic Exercise Program Versus a Resistance and Neuromuscular Exercise Program on Exercise-Induced Hypoalgesia in Knee Osteoarthritis: A Study Protocol for a Randomized Clinical Trial.
items.summary: This randomized, two-arm, controlled, single-blind trial protocol will compare a cycling-based aerobic exercise program with a resistance and neuromuscular exercise program in 90 participants with knee osteoarthritis (KOA) and altered exercise-induced hypoalgesia (EIH). The primary outcome is the between-group difference in within-session change in pressure pain threshold at the knee, averaged over 10 weeks.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 方案旨在探讨哪种运动模式更能改善膝骨关节炎（KOA）患者的运动诱导镇痛（EIH）功能。若研究成功，我们就能更精确地为 KOA 患者，特别是那些 EIH 反应异常的患者，开具运动处方。
items.titleZh: 基于自行车有氧运动与阻力及神经肌肉运动对膝骨关节炎运动诱导镇痛影响的比较：一项随机临床试验方案
items.summaryZh: 这项随机、双臂、对照、单盲试验方案将比较基于自行车的有氧运动项目与阻力及神经肌肉运动项目在 90 名患有膝骨关节炎（KOA）和运动诱导镇痛（EIH）改变的参与者中的效果。主要结局是膝关节内会话压力痛阈变化的组间调整均值差异，该差异将平均 10 周的结果。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT protocol aims to compare the effects of cycling-based aerobic exercise versus resistance and neuromuscular exercise on exercise-induced hypoalgesia (EIH) in knee osteoarthritis (KOA) patients. This may provide a more precise exercise prescription basis for KOA pain management.
items.limitation: 这是一项研究方案，尚未产出实际结果，其潜在影响和结论仍待验证。
items.limitationEn: This is a study protocol, and actual results have not yet been produced, so its potential impact and conclusions remain to be verified.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Centering First Nations parents' voices: a community-directed pediatric rehabilitation needs assessment in Northern Saskatchewan.
items.summary: A community-based participatory action research study in Northern Saskatchewan explored First Nations parents' experiences with pediatric rehabilitation services. Findings highlighted the absence of clear guidance, limited community resources, and the need for strength-based, family-centered, culturally grounded, and community-led services, with hybrid care (in-person and virtual) showing promise.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究强调了加拿大原住民家庭在儿科康复服务中的困境和需求。它呼吁物理治疗师重新审视西方医疗体系对残疾的构建，并倡导以优势为基础、家庭为中心、文化为根基、社区主导的服务模式，对于提升服务公平性有重要指导意义。
items.titleZh: 以原住民父母之声为中心：萨斯喀彻温省北部一项社区导向的儿科康复需求评估
items.summaryZh: 一项在萨斯喀彻温省北部进行的社区参与式行动研究探讨了原住民父母在儿科康复服务方面的经历。研究结果强调了缺乏明确指导、社区资源有限以及对基于优势、以家庭为中心、文化根植和社区主导服务模式的需求，其中混合护理（面诊与虚拟）显示出潜力。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study highlights the challenges and needs of First Nations families in pediatric rehabilitation services in Canada. It calls on physical therapists to critically examine the Western medical system's construction of disability and advocates for strength-based, family-centered, culturally grounded, and community-led service models, which are crucial for improving service equity.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性研究，主要通过家长叙述收集数据，其发现可能受限于样本代表性和主观性，难以普遍推广。
items.limitationEn: This qualitative study, primarily based on parental narratives, may have limitations in sample representativeness and subjectivity, limiting generalizability.

items.title: Effects of Virtual Reality-Assisted Task-Oriented Training on Clinical and Psychosocial Outcomes in Individuals with Rotator Cuff Tears: A Randomized Controlled Single-Blind Trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial found that adding virtual reality-assisted task-oriented training to conventional physiotherapy significantly improved DASH scores by -3.93 points (95% CI, -4.79 to -3.08; p<0.001) and other pain/disability measures in individuals with rotator cuff tears, but the DASH improvement did not reach the MCID.
items.curatedReason: 在肩袖撕裂的常规物理治疗中加入虚拟现实辅助任务导向训练，可带来短期疼痛、功能和运动恐惧的统计学显著改善，但其DASH功能评分的改善量未达到临床最小重要差异。
items.titleZh: 虚拟现实辅助任务导向训练对肩袖撕裂患者临床与心理社会结局的影响：一项随机对照单盲试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验发现，在肩袖撕裂患者的常规物理治疗中加入虚拟现实辅助任务导向训练，能使DASH评分改善-3.93分（95% CI, -4.79 to -3.08; p<0.001），并额外改善疼痛、肩关节相关疼痛和残疾、运动恐惧症和疼痛灾难化，但DASH改善量未达到临床最小重要差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: Adding VR-assisted task-oriented training to conventional physiotherapy for rotator cuff tears shows statistically significant short-term improvements in pain, function, and kinesiophobia, though the DASH score improvement did not reach the minimal clinically important difference.
items.limitation: 该研究的DASH功能评分改善量未达到临床最小重要差异，且需要更长期的随访研究来评估其长期效果。
items.limitationEn: The improvement in DASH scores did not reach the minimal clinically important difference, and longer-term follow-up studies are needed to assess its sustained effects.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Navigating expectation-evidence tensions in musculoskeletal physiotherapy.
items.summary: A professional practice article introduces the Contextually Informed Expectation Alignment framework to help musculoskeletal physiotherapists navigate tensions between patient expectations and evidence-informed care, focusing on systematic elicitation and alignment through shared deliberation.
items.curatedReason: 在管理患者期望与循证护理的潜在冲突时，这个“情境知情期望校准”框架能帮你更系统地评估并引导患者期望，以优化治疗背景效应并维护专业性。
items.titleZh: 在肌肉骨骼物理治疗中驾驭期望与证据的张力。
items.summaryZh: 一篇专业实践文章介绍了“情境知情期望校准”框架，旨在帮助肌肉骨骼物理治疗师系统地评估和分类患者期望（包括一致、不切实际但无害、冲突的期望），并通过共同协商将其与循证护理对齐，从而更好地应对期望与证据之间的张力。
items.curatedReasonEn: When navigating potential conflicts between patient expectations and evidence-informed care, this "Contextually Informed Expectation Alignment" framework can help you systematically elicit and align patient expectations to optimize contextual effects and uphold professional integrity.

items.title: Return to Golf Rehabilitation Progression after Anterior Cruciate Ligament Reconstruction Using an Evidence-Based Foundation.
items.summary: This clinical commentary synthesizes golf biomechanics and ACLR rehabilitation evidence to propose a six-phase, criteria-based progression for return-to-golf after anterior cruciate ligament reconstruction (ACLR), emphasizing assessment of symptoms, ROM, strength, movement quality, and workload tolerance, rather than solely time from surgery.
items.curatedReason: 这份临床评论基于现有证据，提出了ACL重建术后分阶段重返高尔夫球运动的方案，为你指导患者回归这项低冲击但膝关节负荷显著的运动提供了详细的、以标准为基础的指导。
items.titleZh: 基于循证基础的交叉韧带重建术后重返高尔夫康复进展。
items.summaryZh: 这份临床评论综合了高尔夫生物力学和ACL重建康复证据，提出了一项分六个阶段、基于标准的ACL重建术后重返高尔夫方案，强调症状、活动度、力量、运动质量、工作负荷耐受性和信心评估，而非仅以术后时间作为依据。
items.curatedReasonEn: This clinical commentary, based on current evidence, proposes a staged return-to-golf protocol after ACL reconstruction, offering detailed, criteria-based guidance for your patients returning to this low-impact yet knee-demanding sport.
items.limitation: 所提出的方案尚未经过前瞻性验证，其有效性仍需进一步研究证实。
items.limitationEn: The proposed protocol has not yet undergone prospective validation, and its efficacy requires further research.
items.journal: International journal of sports physical therapy

items.title: Adductor-Related Athletic Groin Pain: A Clinical Commentary.
items.summary: This clinical commentary synthesizes current evidence on adductor-related athletic groin pain (ARAGP), providing an evidence-informed framework for its recognition, management, and risk reduction, covering anatomy, risk factors, imaging, prevention, rehabilitation principles, and return-to-sport decision-making.
items.curatedReason: 这份临床评论为你提供了诊断、管理和降低内收肌相关运动性腹股沟疼痛风险的循证框架，特别强调了增强力量、离心负荷和神经肌肉训练的重要性。
items.titleZh: 内收肌相关运动性腹股沟疼痛：一项临床评论。
items.summaryZh: 这份临床评论综合了内收肌相关运动性腹股沟疼痛（ARAGP）的现有证据，提供了一个循证框架，涵盖解剖、危险因素、影像学考虑、预防策略、康复原则和重返运动决策，以帮助临床医生和运动表现专业人员识别、管理和降低其风险。
items.curatedReasonEn: This clinical commentary offers a comprehensive framework for managing adductor-related athletic groin pain. It outlines key evidence-informed principles for recognition, management, and risk reduction, emphasizing the importance of strength, eccentric loading, and neuromuscular training to guide your rehabilitation protocols.
items.limitation: 该评论指出仍需更多研究来阐明损伤机制并优化筛查和预防策略。
items.limitationEn: The commentary highlights the need for further research to clarify injury mechanisms and optimize screening and prevention strategies.
items.journal: International journal of sports physical therapy

items.title: Sarcopenia Assessment in Resource-Constrained Settings: Expert Agreement on Surrogate Measures
items.summary: An expert agreement process identified the five-times sit-to-stand test (5STS) (CVI=0.8-1), Timed Up-and-Go (TUG) (CVI=1), and calf circumference (CC) (CVI=0.7-1) as relevant and appropriate pragmatic proxy measures for assessing sarcopenia in resource-constrained settings, with potential for digital health platform integration.
items.curatedReason: 该专家共识流程识别了五次坐站测试（5STS）、计时起立行走测试（TUG）和小腿围（CC）作为肌少症评估的实用替代指标，这些指标便于在资源受限的环境下或通过数字健康平台进行远程筛查和监测。
items.titleZh: 资源受限环境下肌少症评估：替代指标的专家共识。
items.summaryZh: 一项专家共识流程识别了五次坐站测试（5STS）、计时起立行走测试（TUG）和小腿围（CC）作为评估肌少症的实用替代指标（CVI介于0.7-1之间），这些指标与既定诊断标准概念一致，并有望集成到数字健康平台中，以便在资源受限环境下进行远程筛查和监测。
items.curatedReasonEn: This expert agreement process identified the five-times sit-to-stand test (5STS), Timed Up-and-Go (TUG), and calf circumference (CC) as practical surrogate measures for sarcopenia assessment, facilitating remote screening and monitoring in resource-constrained settings or via digital health platforms.
items.limitation: 这项研究主要基于专家共识，所识别的替代指标的临床有效性、可靠性和远程评估可行性仍需进一步的临床研究来确立。
items.limitationEn: This study is primarily based on expert consensus; the clinical validity, reliability, and feasibility of remote assessment for the identified surrogate measures still require further clinical research for establishment.

items.title: Calcific Patellar Tendinopathy. A Case Report Integrating Diagnostic Ultrasound Throughout a Multi-Modal Treatment Approach.
items.summary: A case report describes the successful integration of diagnostic ultrasound in the multimodal treatment of a 46-year-old female with calcific patellar tendinopathy, combining spinal/extremity manipulation, ultrasound-guided needle fenestration, electrical dry needling, and exercise, leading to clinically meaningful reductions in pain and improved function.
items.curatedReason: 这份病例报告展示了诊断性超声如何指导对髌骨钙化性肌腱病的多模式治疗，包括超声引导的针刺和电干针，提示超声在评估和治疗中的潜在价值。
items.titleZh: 钙化性髌腱病。一份在多模式治疗方法中整合诊断超声的病例报告。
items.summaryZh: 一份病例报告描述了一名46岁钙化性髌腱病患者在24周内接受多模式干预的成功案例，包括脊柱/肢体手法、超声引导针刺、电干针和运动，治疗后NPRS和LEFS均有临床意义的改善，并通过诊断超声确认了钙化灶减少和组织愈合。
items.curatedReasonEn: This case report illustrates how diagnostic ultrasound can guide multimodal treatment for calcific patellar tendinopathy, including ultrasound-guided needle fenestration and electrical dry needling, highlighting its potential value in both assessment and intervention.
items.limitation: 这是一项单病例报告，其发现的普适性受限，需要进一步的高质量研究来验证干预方案的有效性。
items.limitationEn: As a single case report, the generalizability of its findings is limited; further high-quality research is needed to validate the efficacy of the intervention protocol.
items.journal: International journal of sports physical therapy

items.title: Utilization of the Functional Lower Extremity Evaluation (FLEE) in Return-to-Sport Rehabilitation Protocol Following Hip Arthroscopy in Collegiate Athletes: A Case Series.
items.summary: A retrospective case series of four collegiate athletes post-hip arthroscopy for FAI found that the Functional Lower Extremity Evaluation (FLEE) detected improvements in all components, achieving return-to-sport clearance at a mean of 5.75 months. All athletes returned to competitive sports without re-injury or re-operation at a mean follow-up of 52.89 months.
items.curatedReason: 这项小样本病例系列提示，髋关节镜术后，功能性下肢评估（FLEE）可能有助于追踪大学运动员的康复进展和肢体对称性，作为评估返场能力的一个潜在客观工具。所有4名运动员平均在5.75个月时复训，52.89个月内无再损伤或再手术。
items.titleZh: 功能性下肢评估（FLEE）在大学运动员髋关节镜术后重返运动康复方案中的应用：病例系列研究。
items.summaryZh: 一项针对4名大学运动员髋关节镜术后的回顾性病例系列研究显示，功能性下肢评估（FLEE）可检测到所有组件的改善，运动员在平均5.75个月时获得重返运动许可，所有运动员均以相同或更高水平重返竞技体育，平均随访52.89个月无再损伤或再手术。
items.curatedReasonEn: This small case series suggests that post-hip arthroscopy, the Functional Lower Extremity Evaluation (FLEE) may help track rehabilitation progress and limb symmetry in collegiate athletes, offering a potential objective tool for return-to-sport assessment. All 4 athletes returned to sport at a mean of 5.75 months, with no re-injury or re-operation at 52.89 months.
items.limitation: 这是一项回顾性病例系列研究，样本量小（4名运动员），且缺乏对照组，因此其发现的普适性受限，需要更大规模的前瞻性研究验证。
items.limitationEn: This is a retrospective case series with a small sample size (4 athletes) and no control group, limiting the generalizability of its findings; larger, prospective studies are needed for validation.
items.journal: International journal of sports physical therapy

items.title: The effects of robot assisted therapy on upper limb functions and gait parameters in cerebral palsy: A randomized controlled trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial found that adding upper extremity robotic-assisted training to conventional physiotherapy significantly improved upper limb functions (e.g., wrist flexion mean change 10.37±6.99° vs 1.13±3.02°) and positively influenced gait parameters (e.g., stance phase of unaffected side mean change 2.56±3.03% vs -0.93±2.18%) in children with cerebral palsy.
items.curatedReason: 对脑瘫儿童而言，在常规物理治疗中加入上肢机器人辅助治疗，不仅能改善上肢功能，还能积极影响步态参数，提示你可以考虑将其作为综合康复方案的一部分。
items.titleZh: 机器人辅助治疗对脑瘫患者上肢功能和步态参数的影响：一项随机对照试验。
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验显示，对脑瘫患儿在常规物理治疗中加入上肢机器人辅助训练，不仅显著改善了腕关节屈曲（平均变化10.37°±6.99° vs 1.13°±3.02°）和前臂旋后（中位数变化17.5° [IQR 16.0] vs 2.0° [IQR 5.0]）等上肢功能，还积极影响了步态参数，如健侧支撑期。
items.curatedReasonEn: For children with cerebral palsy, adding upper extremity robotic-assisted therapy to conventional physiotherapy not only improves upper limb function but also positively influences gait parameters, suggesting it can be considered as part of a comprehensive rehabilitation program.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小，且随访时间有限，因此其长期效果和在更广泛人群中的普适性需要进一步验证。
items.limitationEn: The study has a small sample size and limited follow-up, so its long-term effects and generalizability across a broader population require further validation.

items.title: Walking speed and propulsion asymmetry as distinct diagnostic biomarkers of gait impairment: Towards precision rehabilitation after stroke
items.summary: A cross-sectional study of 57 individuals with chronic hemiparesis classified gait impairment by walking speed (<0.8 m/s) and propulsion asymmetry (>31.5%). It found that both speed and asymmetry were independent predictors of metabolic cost (R2=0.70, p < 0.001) and ambulatory function, reflecting distinct underlying biomechanical mechanisms (paretic propulsive power vs. distal-to-proximal power shift).
items.curatedReason: 这项研究强调，中风后偏瘫患者的步速和推进不对称是反映代谢成本和步行功能的独立指标。识别步速低于0.8米/秒和推进不对称超过31.5%的患者，能帮你更精准地进行患者分型，从而制定针对性的神经康复策略。
items.titleZh: 步速和推进不对称作为步态障碍的独立诊断生物标志物：迈向卒中后精准康复。
items.summaryZh: 一项对57名慢性偏瘫患者的横断面研究发现，步速和推进不对称是步态障碍的独立预测因子（例如代谢成本 R2=0.70, p < 0.001），并反映了不同的生物力学机制。慢步速与偏瘫侧推进力减弱相关，而高度不对称则表明从踝关节到髋关节的力生成发生远近端转移。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study highlights that walking speed and propulsion asymmetry are independent indicators of metabolic cost and ambulatory function in chronic hemiparesis post-stroke. Identifying patients with walking speeds below 0.8 m/s and propulsion asymmetry exceeding 31.5% can help you more precisely phenotype patients to tailor neurorehabilitation strategies.
items.limitation: 这是一项横断面研究，无法建立因果关系，且需要前瞻性研究来验证这些生物标志物在指导康复干预中的预测价值。
items.limitationEn: As a cross-sectional study, it cannot establish causality; prospective studies are needed to validate the predictive value of these biomarkers in guiding rehabilitation interventions.

items.title: Errorless learning of a video call in Alzheimer Disease: verbal motor error dissociation as a potential marker of procedural learning (a pilot study)
items.summary: A pilot study of 20 Alzheimer's disease patients showed that errorless learning enabled them to acquire a three-step video call procedure on a touchscreen, with mean execution time falling from 41.7 to 23.3 seconds. A dissociation between verbal and motor errors was observed, supporting the use of preserved procedural memory in rehabilitation.
items.curatedReason: 这项初步研究提示，错误更少学习法可以帮助阿尔茨海默病患者学习日常交流任务，例如视频通话，并且言语和运动错误的差异可能是程序性学习的潜在标志，支持将保留的程序性记忆应用于康复。
items.titleZh: 阿尔茨海默病患者视频通话的无错学习：言语运动错误分离作为程序性学习的潜在标志（一项初步研究）。
items.summaryZh: 一项针对20名阿尔茨海默病患者的初步研究显示，通过无错学习，患者学会了三步视频通话流程，平均执行时间从41.7秒降至23.3秒。研究发现言语和运动错误存在显著分离，言语错误减少，运动错误增加，这与程序性学习中保留的程序性记忆与外显言语报告的脱离相符，支持其在康复中的应用。
items.curatedReasonEn: This pilot study suggests that errorless learning can help individuals with Alzheimer's Disease acquire daily communication tasks, like making a video call, and the dissociation between verbal and motor errors may be a potential marker of procedural learning, supporting the use of preserved procedural memory in rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 这是一项初步（pilot）研究，样本量小（20名患者），且未设置对照组，其结果的普适性受限，需要更大规模的随机对照试验来验证。
items.limitationEn: As a pilot study, it has a small sample size (20 patients) and lacks a control group, limiting the generalizability of its findings; larger randomized controlled trials are needed for validation.

items.title: Integrating Wearable Sensor Technology into Outpatient Rehabilitation Care: A Proof-of-Concept Study
items.summary: A 9-month proof-of-concept study integrated wearable sensor data into outpatient rehabilitation EHRs, involving 17 clinicians and 38 patients. Patient adherence to daily data syncing was 68.6%, and clinicians viewed sensor data in 81.9% of visits. User-friendliness received a "good" rating, demonstrating feasibility and usability for bridging the gap between clinic visits and daily life.
items.curatedReason: 这项概念验证研究展示了将可穿戴传感器技术集成到门诊康复电子健康记录（EHR）的可行性和可用性，为你提供了克服临床评估与日常活动目标之间脱节的潜在解决方案。
items.titleZh: 将可穿戴传感器技术集成到门诊康复护理中：一项概念验证研究。
items.summaryZh: 一项为期9个月的概念验证研究将可穿戴传感器数据集成到门诊康复电子健康记录（EHR）中，涉及17名临床医生和38名患者。患者日常数据同步依从率为68.6%，临床医生在81.9%的门诊访问中查看了传感器数据，用户友好度获得“良好”评价，证明了其连接诊所访问与日常生活情境的可行性和可用性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This proof-of-concept study suggests that integrating wearable sensor data into outpatient rehabilitation EHRs is feasible and usable. With 68.6% patient adherence to daily data syncing and clinicians viewing data in 81.9% of visits, it shows potential to help you bridge the gap between clinic assessments and patients' daily activity goals.
items.limitation: 这项研究是一个概念验证，仅在一个机构进行，且未评估其对临床结局的实际影响，因此需要更大规模、多中心的实施研究来验证其长期效益。
items.limitationEn: This is a single-institution proof-of-concept study that did not evaluate the actual impact on clinical outcomes; larger, multi-center implementation studies are needed to validate its long-term benefits.

items.title: Effectiveness of photobiomodulation therapy associated with multimodal therapeutic intervention program versus multimodal therapeutic intervention program in chronic non-specific neck pain: A randomized controlled trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial found that adding photobiomodulation therapy (PBMT) to a multimodal therapeutic intervention program (MTIP) did not provide further improvements in functional disability or pain intensity compared to MTIP alone in individuals with chronic nonspecific neck pain.
items.curatedReason: 对于慢性非特异性颈痛，将特定剂量的光生物调节疗法（PBMT）加入多模式治疗干预计划，并未比单独的多模式治疗带来额外益处，这意味着在当前剂量下不建议常规联合使用。
items.titleZh: 光生物调节疗法联合多模式治疗干预计划与单独多模式治疗干预计划治疗慢性非特异性颈痛的有效性：一项随机对照试验。
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验显示，对于慢性非特异性颈痛患者，在多模式治疗干预计划（MTIP）中加入特定剂量的光生物调节疗法（PBMT），并未比单独MTIP在功能残疾和疼痛强度方面带来额外改善。例如，MTIP组在干预后功能残疾改善4.06分（95% CI 2.83 to 5.28），优于联合组。
items.curatedReasonEn: For chronic nonspecific neck pain, adding specific-dose photobiomodulation therapy (PBMT) to a multimodal therapeutic intervention program provided no additional benefits over the multimodal program alone, suggesting against routine combined use at this dosage.
items.limitation: 本研究是在特定PBMT剂量条件下进行的，结果可能不适用于其他剂量方案。
items.limitationEn: This study was conducted under specific PBMT dosage conditions, and the results may not be generalizable to other dosage regimens.

items.title: Digital therapeutic combining exercise and cognitive-behavioural therapy reduces pain in patients with chronic patellofemoral pain: a multicentre randomised controlled trial.
items.summary: An 8-week smartphone-based digital therapeutic combining exercise and cognitive-behavioral therapy reduced usual knee pain by 12.5 mm (95% CI -17.1 to -7.8) at 8 weeks compared to education and exercise instruction in 216 patients with chronic patellofemoral pain.
items.curatedReason: 针对髌股关节疼痛，这种结合运动和认知行为疗法的数字疗法在短期内显著缓解了患者的疼痛并改善了膝关节功能。考虑将其作为辅助手段。
items.titleZh: 结合运动与认知行为疗法的数字疗法可减轻慢性髌股关节疼痛患者的疼痛：一项多中心随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项为期 8 周的智能手机数字疗法（结合运动与认知行为疗法）在 216 名慢性髌股关节疼痛患者中，与传统教育和运动指导相比，在 8 周时显著减轻了膝关节疼痛，平均差异为 -12.5 毫米（95% CI -17.1 至 -7.8）。
items.curatedReasonEn: For patellofemoral pain, this digital therapeutic combining exercise and CBT significantly reduced pain and improved knee function in the short term. Consider it as an adjunctive treatment.
items.limitation: 研究观察期较短（12 周），长期效果和依从性仍需更多证据。
items.limitationEn: The study had a relatively short observation period (12 weeks); long-term efficacy and adherence require further evidence.

items.title: Is therapeutic exercise as a standalone intervention effective in reducing kinesiophobia in adults with nonspecific chronic low back pain? A systematic review and meta-analysis with meta-regression
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis found that therapeutic exercise as a standalone intervention is effective in reducing kinesiophobia in adults with nonspecific chronic low back pain.
items.curatedReason: 运动疗法作为单一干预措施，能有效减轻非特异性慢性腰痛患者的运动恐惧症。你有充分的证据，应将其作为一线策略来应对患者的心理障碍。
items.titleZh: 运动疗法作为单一干预措施能否有效减少非特异性慢性腰痛成人患者的运动恐惧症？一项带 Meta 回归的系统综述和 Meta 分析
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述和 Meta 分析发现，运动疗法作为单一干预措施，在减少非特异性慢性腰痛成人患者的运动恐惧症方面是有效的。
items.curatedReasonEn: Therapeutic exercise as a standalone intervention effectively reduces kinesiophobia in adults with nonspecific chronic low back pain. You now have strong evidence to implement it as a first-line strategy for patients’ psychological barriers.
items.limitation: 研究结果可能存在发表偏倚，且不同研究的运动方案和评估方法存在异质性。
items.limitationEn: The study results may be subject to publication bias, and there is heterogeneity in exercise protocols and assessment methods across different studies.

related.title: Is therapeutic exercise as a standalone intervention effective in reducing kinesiophobia in adults with nonspecific chronic low back pain? A systematic review and meta-analysis with meta-regression.

items.title: Effects of Transcranial Direct Current Stimulation and Individualized Physical Therapy on Pain and Function in Individuals With Chronic Knee Pain: A Pilot Study.
items.summary: A pilot study with 30 participants found that active tDCS combined with individualized PT showed no significant differences in primary patient-centered pain and functional outcomes for chronic knee pain compared to sham tDCS, though improvements in pain sensitivity and quadriceps strength were observed for secondary outcomes.
items.curatedReason: 经颅直流电刺激（tDCS）结合个体化物理治疗对慢性膝关节疼痛的患者中心结局无显著影响。别急着把它加入常规方案，目前证据只停留在疼痛敏感性和股四头肌力量的次要指标上。
items.titleZh: 经颅直流电刺激联合个体化物理治疗对慢性膝关节疼痛患者疼痛和功能的影响：一项试点研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 30 名慢性膝关节疼痛患者的试点研究显示，经颅直流电刺激（tDCS）结合个体化物理治疗对患者中心化的主要疼痛和功能结局无显著影响，但在疼痛敏感性和股四头肌力量方面，tDCS 组优于假刺激组。
items.curatedReasonEn: Transcranial direct current stimulation (tDCS) combined with individualized physical therapy showed no significant impact on patient-centered outcomes for chronic knee pain. Do not rush to integrate it into routine protocols; current evidence only supports secondary outcomes like pain sensitivity and quadriceps strength.
items.limitation: 这是一项初步试点研究，样本量较小，主要疼痛和功能结局无显著组间差异。
items.limitationEn: This was a preliminary pilot study with a small sample size, and no significant between-group differences were observed for primary pain and functional outcomes.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Load-dependent Motor Cortical Activation Assessed by fNIRS Is Partially Preserved After Stroke.
items.summary: A cross-sectional study of 12 stroke patients found that proportional load-dependent hemodynamic cortical responses during upper limb lifting tasks were preserved only in the ipsilesional posterior parietal cortex, unlike healthy controls who showed responses in multiple motor areas.
items.curatedReason: 卒中后患者在上肢运动中仍保留部分负荷依赖性皮层激活，尤其在病灶侧顶叶后部。这提示了其在卒中康复中作为神经调控干预和监测皮层参与的潜在靶点。
items.titleZh: 卒中后负荷依赖性运动皮层激活（通过 fNIRS 评估）部分保留
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 12 名卒中患者的横断面研究发现，上肢运动时负荷依赖性皮层血流动力学反应仅在病灶侧后顶叶皮层保留，提示其可能具有代偿作用，可作为卒中上肢康复中神经调控和皮层参与监测的潜在靶点。
items.curatedReasonEn: Post-stroke patients retain partial load-dependent cortical activation during upper limb exercise, particularly in the ipsilesional posterior parietal cortex. This suggests its potential as a target for neuromodulation interventions and monitoring cortical engagement in stroke rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 研究样本量小，为横断面设计，无法建立因果关系，且健康对照组的负荷设置与卒中组不同。
items.limitationEn: The study has a small sample size, a cross-sectional design preventing causal inference, and different load settings for healthy controls versus stroke patients.
items.journal: American journal of physical medicine & rehabilitation

items.title: Adapted cardiac rehabilitation for individuals after stroke and transient ischaemic attack: A scoping review.
items.summary: A scoping review of 19 studies (1951 participants) found that adapted cardiac rehabilitation for individuals after stroke and TIA is safe, feasible, and acceptable, though evidence for effectiveness and inclusion of those with moderate to severe disability is limited.
items.curatedReason: 卒中和短暂性脑缺血发作（TIA）后患者的改良心脏康复是安全、可行且可接受的。这提示可以更积极地探索将心脏康复模型应用于这部分患者，但要关注纳入中重度残疾患者的挑战。
items.titleZh: 卒中和短暂性脑缺血发作后患者的改良心脏康复：一项范围审查
items.summaryZh: 一项包含 19 项研究（1951 名参与者）的范围审查发现，针对卒中和短暂性脑缺血发作后患者的改良心脏康复是安全、可行且可接受的，但关于有效性以及中重度残疾患者纳入的数据有限。
items.curatedReasonEn: Adapted cardiac rehabilitation for patients after stroke and TIA is safe, feasible, and acceptable. This suggests actively exploring the application of cardiac rehabilitation models to these patients, while being mindful of the challenges in including those with moderate to severe disabilities.
items.limitation: 纳入研究的方法学质量各异，且缺乏关于中度或重度残疾卒中患者纳入心脏康复项目有效性的数据。
items.limitationEn: The methodological quality of included studies varied, and there is limited data regarding the effectiveness of including people with moderate or severe stroke disability in cardiac rehabilitation programs.

items.title: Efficacy of a soft robotic exoskeleton for upper-limb rehabilitation in subacute stroke inpatient rehabilitation: a randomised controlled trial
items.summary: This randomized controlled trial investigates the efficacy of a soft robotic exoskeleton for upper-limb rehabilitation in subacute stroke inpatient rehabilitation.
items.curatedReason: 软体机器人外骨骼可能对亚急性卒中住院患者的上肢康复有益，但别急于推广。其长期疗效和成本效益仍需更多RCT证据支持。
items.titleZh: 软体机器人外骨骼对亚急性卒中住院患者上肢康复的疗效：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 这项随机对照试验旨在评估软体机器人外骨骼在亚急性卒中住院患者上肢康复中的疗效。
items.curatedReasonEn: A soft robotic exoskeleton may benefit upper-limb rehabilitation for subacute stroke inpatients, but don't rush to adopt it. More RCTs are needed to confirm its long-term efficacy and cost-effectiveness.
items.limitation: 研究的长期效果和对不同卒中严重程度患者的适用性未详细阐明。
items.limitationEn: The long-term effects of the study and its applicability to patients with different stroke severities were not detailed.

items.title: Now Available: Resources Offer a Practical Look at How PT Codes Are Valued
items.summary: APTA has released two new resources to help physical therapists, physical therapist assistants, and students understand how payment rates are established and the policies influencing payment for physical therapist services.
items.curatedReason: APTA 发布了关于物理治疗编码定价和支付政策的新资源。如果你在美国执业，务必立即查阅，这直接影响你的报销和实践运营。
items.titleZh: APTA 发布：提供 PT 编码定价实用指南的资源现已上线
items.summaryZh: 美国物理治疗协会 (APTA) 发布了两项新资源，旨在帮助物理治疗师、物理治疗师助理和学生了解物理治疗服务的定价方式及影响支付的政策。
items.curatedReasonEn: APTA has released new resources on physical therapy coding valuation and payment policies. If you practice in the U.S., you must review these immediately, as they directly impact your reimbursement and practice operations.

items.title: Non-Biologic Injections in Sports Medicine
items.summary: This review provides an overview of commonly used non-biologic injectates in musculoskeletal care, including corticosteroids, local anesthetics, NSAIDs, normal saline, dextrose prolotherapy, hyaluronic acid, and botulinum toxin, discussing their mechanisms, adverse effects, and clinical evidence in sports medicine.
items.curatedReason: 这篇综述清晰梳理了非生物注射剂在运动医学中的作用。在考虑使用皮质类固醇时，请权衡其短期止痛效果与长期对关节软骨和肌腱的潜在风险。
items.titleZh: 运动医学中的非生物注射剂
items.summaryZh: 本综述概述了肌肉骨骼护理中常用的非生物注射剂，包括皮质类固醇、局部麻醉剂、非甾体抗炎药、生理盐水、葡萄糖增殖疗法、透明质酸和肉毒杆菌毒素，并讨论了它们在运动医学中的作用机制、不良反应和临床证据。
items.curatedReasonEn: This review clearly outlines the role of non-biologic injections in sports medicine. When considering corticosteroids, weigh their short-term analgesic effects against potential long-term risks to articular cartilage and tendons.
items.limitation: 作为一篇综述，其证据级别低于系统综述或RCT，结论可能受限于其所引用研究的质量和偏倚。
items.limitationEn: As a review, its evidence level is lower than a systematic review or RCT, and conclusions may be limited by the quality and bias of the studies cited.

items.title: Educational Videos Were Not Superior to a Folder in Improving Urinary Incontinence Knowledge and Symptoms: A Randomized Controlled Trial
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial found that educational videos were not superior to a simple folder in improving urinary incontinence knowledge and symptoms.
items.curatedReason: 针对尿失禁患者的教育视频在改善知识和症状方面未优于简单的文件夹。这意味着你日常的口头指导和书面材料可能已经足够，无需投入大量资源开发视频内容。
items.titleZh: 教育视频在改善尿失禁知识和症状方面不优于文件夹：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验显示，教育视频在改善尿失禁知识和症状方面，并未优于简单的纸质文件夹。
items.curatedReasonEn: Educational videos for urinary incontinence patients were not superior to simple folders in improving knowledge and symptoms. This implies that your usual verbal instructions and written materials may be sufficient, without the need for significant resources to develop video content.
items.limitation: 研究的随访时间未提及，无法评估长期效果；且患者对信息媒介的偏好可能因文化和个体差异而异。
items.limitationEn: The follow-up duration of the study was not mentioned, preventing evaluation of long-term effects; also, patient preferences for information media may vary due to cultural and individual differences.

items.title: Multisensory training with telerehabilitation for brain injured children with visual field defects
items.summary: This research investigates multisensory training with telerehabilitation for brain-injured children with visual field defects.
items.curatedReason: 针对有视野缺损的脑损伤儿童，多感官训练结合远程康复显示出可行性。远程康复增加了服务可及性，但其有效性仍需更强的证据支持。
items.titleZh: 针对有视野缺损的脑损伤儿童的多感官训练结合远程康复
items.summaryZh: 这项研究探讨了对有视野缺损的脑损伤儿童进行多感官训练结合远程康复的效果。
items.curatedReasonEn: Multisensory training with telerehabilitation is feasible for brain-injured children with visual field defects. While telerehabilitation improves accessibility, its efficacy still requires stronger evidence.
items.limitation: 研究设计未明确，样本量未提及，需要进一步的对照研究来验证其有效性。
items.limitationEn: The study design and sample size were not specified, and further controlled studies are needed to validate its effectiveness.

items.title: Artificial intelligence and wearable technology in athlete load management and injury prediction: a systematic literature review
items.summary: This systematic review analyzes the status of artificial intelligence and wearable devices in athlete load management and injury prediction, aiming to summarize information for functional, physiological, and biomechanical areas.
items.curatedReason: 人工智能和可穿戴技术在运动员负荷管理和伤病预测方面的潜力巨大。但这篇综述本身是方法学综述，提醒你当前该领域的研究还处于早期阶段，实证数据有限。
items.titleZh: 人工智能和可穿戴技术在运动员负荷管理和伤病预测中的应用：一项系统文献综述
items.summaryZh: 这项系统综述分析了人工智能和可穿戴设备在运动员负荷管理和伤病预测中的现状，旨在总结功能、生理和生物力学领域的信息。
items.curatedReasonEn: Artificial intelligence and wearable technology hold immense potential in athlete load management and injury prediction. However, this review is methodological in nature, reminding you that research in this field is still in its early stages with limited empirical data.
items.limitation: 这项系统综述主要侧重于文献分析，缺乏实证数据和临床应用结果的深入探讨。
